notes.title: Official Release of Unstoppable: Breakout
notes.content:
Are you ready to uncover the truth?

The full version of Unstoppable: Breakout has been officially released today, Friday, August 30th, at 09:00 KST!

Unstoppable: Breakout is an action game where a researcher trapped in a mysterious incident seeks to uncover the truth. The game’s soul-based system, along with its unique atmosphere and distinctive narration, will immerse you even further.

Thanks to the feedback we’ve received through various events and closed beta tests, we were able to create a more enjoyable game. We consider this game as something created together with many of you. We want to take this opportunity to express our heartfelt gratitude. 

Thank you.

notes.title: Official Release Announcement
notes.content:
[Official Release Announcement]

Hello,

We are excited to announce the official release of Unstoppable: Breakout.

After addressing numerous improvements and bug fixes, we are finally ready for the official launch. On August 30, 2024, you will be able to experience the full story of Unstoppable: Breakout.

At FunnyRocks, we’ve put in a great deal of effort to deliver a unique experience that sets our game apart, offering something unlike the typical soul games you might be familiar with.

We hope you thoroughly enjoy the message we aim to convey.

Thank you.
